title: Scope unevaluated completion documentation to bound criteria
outcome: Make the registered Git-input documentation accurately state when unevaluated completion checks a supplied source declaration, without promising checks for unbound criteria.
acceptance: The registered Git-input section explicitly scopes optional recorded-input fallback and exact supplied-declaration matching at unevaluated completion to bound criteria.

Documentation no longer implies that an unevaluated completion with no acceptance binding rejects every mismatched Git declaration; runtime behavior and evaluated-completion safeguards remain unchanged.
